LanguageData.Ceramics.label: Normal Ceramic
LanguageData.Ceramics.description: Glazed ceramics fired from clay and glass batch in a kiln. The base tier of the ceramic system.
LanguageData.Miho_Ceramics.label: High Grade Ceramic
LanguageData.Miho_Ceramics.description: Advanced ceramics made by refining ordinary ceramics with metal. Strong and versatile, used for high-grade equipment.
LanguageData.Miho_MilitaryGradeBalisticCeramics.label: Military Grade Ceramic
LanguageData.Miho_MilitaryGradeBalisticCeramics.descr: A reinforced ceramic fused with steel, used for military-grade armor and weapons.
LanguageData.Miho_CelestialScale.label: Celestial Scale
LanguageData.Miho_CelestialScale.description: The most powerful alloy in history, made of compressed plasteel and exotic negative-mass matter.
